title: AI chat therapist subscription (reordered pitch)
idea: The backend is a single frontier LLM provider behind a long system prompt, plus RAG over CBT worksheets — no human clinicians in the loop. Crisis keywords trigger a static hotline message. In the footer, in small text, we say 'always available support, not a replacement for licensed care'. Launch markets are the US and Indonesia. It is sold as a consumer subscription at $19/month, and what the user gets is 24/7 AI 'therapy-style' chat for anxiety and mild depression.
focus_notes: Quality ceiling / harmful advice / hallucination in clinical-adjacent domain
Trust collapse after one viral failure story
